from unittest import TestCase from mistune.toc import render_toc_ul, add_toc_hook from mistune import create_markdown class TestAutoseIssue4E2E(TestCase): def test_unordered_toc_and_backward_compatibility(self): # AC-FR-001-1: single item, default ordered=False (or omitted) toc1 = [(1, 'intro', 'Introduction')] self.assertEqual( render_toc_ul(toc1), '
    \n
  • Introduction
    • \n
\n' ) self.assertEqual( render_toc_ul(toc1, ordered=False), '
    \n
  • Introduction
    • \n
\n' ) # AC-FR-001-2: nested items with ordered=False toc2 = [(1, 'a', 'A'), (2, 'b', 'B')] self.assertEqual( render_toc_ul(toc2, ordered=False), '
    \n
  • A\n
      \n
    • B
      • \n
    \n
    • \n
\n' ) def test_ordered_toc(self): # AC-FR-002-1: single item with ordered=True toc1 = [(1, 'intro', 'Introduction')] self.assertEqual( render_toc_ul(toc1, ordered=True), '
    \n
  1. Introduction
    2. \n
\n' ) # AC-FR-002-2: nested items with ordered=True toc2 = [(1, 'a', 'A'), (2, 'b', 'B')] self.assertEqual( render_toc_ul(toc2, ordered=True), '
    \n
  1. A\n
      \n
    1. B
      2. \n
    \n
    2. \n
\n' ) # AC-FR-002-3: nested items then sibling with ordered=True toc3 = [(1, 'a', 'A'), (2, 'b', 'B'), (1, 'c', 'C')] self.assertEqual( render_toc_ul(toc3, ordered=True), '
    \n
  1. A\n
      \n
    1. B
      2. \n
    \n
    2. \n
  2. C
    3. \n
\n' ) def test_regression_empty_toc(self): # Regression test for empty iterable and filtered iterables self.assertEqual(render_toc_ul([]), "") self.assertEqual(render_toc_ul(filter(lambda _: False, [])), "") def test_regression_markdown_toc_hook(self): # Regression test for markdown parsing with add_toc_hook and render_toc_ul md = create_markdown(escape=False) add_toc_hook(md) html, state = md.parse("# Hello\n\n## World") toc_html = render_toc_ul(state.env["toc_items"]) self.assertIn('Hello', toc_html) self.assertIn('World', toc_html) self.assertTrue(toc_html.startswith("
    \n")) def test_integration_ordered_toc_hook(self): # Integration test using markdown parser with state env and rendering ordered TOC md = create_markdown(escape=False) add_toc_hook(md) _, state = md.parse("# Section 1\n\n## Subsection 1.1\n\n# Section 2") toc_html = render_toc_ul(state.env["toc_items"], ordered=True) self.assertTrue(toc_html.startswith("
      \n")) self.assertIn('
        \n
      1. Subsection 1.1
        2. \n
      ', toc_html) self.assertIn('
    1. Section 2
      2. ', toc_html) self.assertTrue(toc_html.endswith("
    \n"))
